samples.question: Panel A is the left panel and panel B is the right panel. Each panel contains several separated colored pieces, some with enclosed background pockets. Let C be the number of connected colored pieces and H the number of background pockets completely surrounded by colored ink; compute C minus H for each panel. Which panel has the larger value? Answer A, B, or tie; ties and differences below 2 are quarantined.
